description.zh: 用通俗的话帮你弄清日常法律问题：被辞退、欠薪、加班、网购纠纷、租房押金、借钱不还；计算经济补偿、加班费和仲裁上诉等期限，梳理证据，起草仲裁申请书、起诉状和投诉信，告诉你该找哪个部门。仅供参考，不构成法律意见。
description.en: Explains everyday legal issues in plain words: dismissals, unpaid wages, overtime, online shopping disputes, rental deposits and unpaid loans; calculates severance, overtime and legal deadlines, organizes evidence, drafts claims and complaints, and points you to the right office. Not legal advice.

welcome_message.zh: 把遇到的事情经过告诉我，我帮你理清楚
welcome_message.en: Tell me what happened and I'll help you sort it out

prompt.zh: 我 ___ 入职，___ 被公司辞退，离职前月均工资 ___，能拿多少补偿？
prompt.en: I joined on ___ and was dismissed on ___, average monthly pay ___. What compensation am I owed?

prompt.zh: 月薪 ___，这个月工作日加班 ___ 小时，周末 ___ 小时，加班费该是多少？
prompt.en: Monthly pay ___, ___ weekday overtime hours and ___ weekend hours. What's my overtime pay?

prompt.zh: 我 ___ 收到 ___（判决书/仲裁裁决），最晚什么时候要上诉/起诉？
prompt.en: I received the ___ (judgment/award) on ___. What's my deadline to appeal or sue?

prompt.zh: 我在 ___ 买的 ___ 出现 ___ 问题，商家不给退，怎么维权？帮我写投诉。
prompt.en: I bought ___ on ___ and it has ___; the seller won't refund. How do I complain?

prompt.zh: 退租后房东以 ___ 为由不退押金 ___ 元，我该怎么办？
prompt.en: After moving out, the landlord keeps my ___ deposit citing ___. What can I do?

prompt.zh: 帮我起草一份 ___（劳动仲裁申请书/起诉状），事实是 ___。
prompt.en: Draft a ___ (labor arbitration claim/civil complaint). The facts are ___.

zh: 仲裁或上诉期限前 7 天「09:00」提醒准备材料
期限前 1 天「09:00」再次提醒最后期限
每周一「10:00」汇总进行中的维权事项和下一步
投诉提交后第 7 天「10:00」提醒查看处理进度
开庭前 3 天「19:00」整理证据清单和陈述要点
每月 1 日「10:00」检查借条、欠款的诉讼时效是否需要催告
en: 7 days before an arbitration or appeal deadline at 09:00, remind to prepare documents
The day before the deadline at 09:00, remind again
Every Monday at 10:00, summarize open disputes and next steps
7 days after filing a complaint at 10:00, remind to check its status
3 days before a hearing at 19:00, compile the evidence list and key statements
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, check whether any debt claims need a written demand
